items.title: Musk Says Cybercab “Covers About 90%” of Passenger Miles. Tesla’s Next Robotaxi Is a Wheel-Less Model Y
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said at the DealBook Summit that Tesla plans an autonomous Model Y with no steering wheel or pedals, built for groups of six or seven riders. Building robotaxis from Tesla’s most popular car could get it to volume faster than the two-seat Cybercab alone.
